## Valley National Bancorp to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Earnings


October 7, 2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 227 KB](https://s204.q4cdn.com/203646286/files/doc_news/Valley-National-Bancorp-to-Announce-Third-Quarter-2026-Earnings-2026.pdf)


NEW YORK, Oct. 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Valley National Bancorp ( **NASDAQ:VLY** ), the holding company for Valley National Bank, announced that it will release its third quarter 2026 earnings before the market opens on Thursday, October 22, 2026.


Valley’s CEO, Ira Robbins will host a conference call on Thursday, October 22, 2026 at 8:30 AM (ET) to discuss Valley’s third quarter 2026 earnings. Interested parties should pre-register using this link:[https://register-conf.media-server.com/register/BIc78e7eea64034897b9189c4e4fb690d9](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=QJZA2Le9AoOlFXDFT7lA3OmUCH6BmGtqIT8ETmbSEglnOtK8R-LjhzT94DrImsuQ3V_71hTyzsJy0Y2EdDg77KmPZrBTAK6QpdTtbgINuF9RObargx--mX2huuHLnx5pwUqBhWL30ekd45K0nctNB5SdGF5QTUisu1ZBLU84U1u-0Nz7SoNocUYqZEvqm0asmRfkov2mlz73dcHA3_A6bAWKzWMwwgRgngrQuXJI6H48oMtfiuKzPtu91c4Jq_aEYKVSX54DfO39n8u0Wn-JVYVBL9mwL6S368suhblbHHS0F06ScN_KQXETI1CCIzejLpCBaINIoj5Xh1e0-mw4cN37d8fpJdZc8HZ1YXJBHWvfLQe8DjwNfPIVswbOzduSPvyYlnaUY0zoleJQc84SKkAkis_WkvbO7J1ktq03uUte9DyC2kNzkBqJLn9edD8w) to receive the dial-in number and a personal PIN, which are required to access the conference call.


The teleconference will also be webcast live:[https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/8hirkq3z](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=QJZA2Le9AoOlFXDFT7lA3HyzvqAw_buHStG020krmqFZjMsZ_Htjim3Ws2EIKevaKCc4BMz10FN2mtt9Yc5VQsgDAAn_30JAEcc_sb7IhH14WsG6Q7TAogOqqYG05so7pqhpZUcgjxCfOMdVLDgLfGK2KnnCocscle8nNS42J0RKLW8etsOGzuUNdfcL-2V4QaML9-VOgbHTO5MGE10XuHB8ElF3Vho6r3ME4A5ko9TpXp-r1YR6hDosSsricxtfWxPzTnWBAHRECSmgXzd8hU6E_1H3SwIYJMXMzmV2DEJZLt9QDuqBFLx5U7N0TOA3UFR3-dqDLu5Wulgt-M87uQ==) and archived on Valley’s website through Monday, November 23, 2026.


Investor presentation materials will be made available prior to the conference call at[www.valley.com](http://www.valley.com/) .


**About Valley**


As the principal subsidiary of Valley National Bancorp, Valley National Bank is a regional financial institution with over $66 billion in assets. Founded in 1927, Valley has more than 220 branch locations and commercial offices nationwide and serves clients across New Jersey, New York, Florida, Alabama, California, Illinois, Pennsylvania and Arizona. Valley delivers a full range of consumer, commercial, and wealth management solutions designed to support everything from homeownership and business growth to long-term financial planning. Big enough to support complex financial needs and small enough to stay deeply connected, Valley is grounded in a relationship-led approach focused on understanding people first. That same relationship-led approach guides Valley’s commitment to community investment and responsible corporate citizenship. To learn more, visit[www.valley.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=0sEXW6k1UmXRHDMCIH4QGj6Z-bAaaHUjnVKXUxUCx7CLrbGmaC8mx01n7nCT3ZODSnjOdoflLeS-6Ffh8CbM9g==) or call the Valley Customer Care Center at 800-522-4100.
